Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU), or any of its subsidiaries, departments, or affiliates.\n\nThis is an independent, community-developed application. The official SPPU website is:

• Result listings fetched from SPPU's portal
• Seat number and mother's name (entered by you to view results)
• CAPTCHA images from SPPU's server
What is stored locally on YOUR device:

• Basic result metadata (title, date, URL) in local SQLite database
• Downloaded result files (in your Downloads folder)
What is NEVER transmitted to third parties:

• Your seat number
• Your mother's name
• Your downloaded results
• Any personal information
All communication happens ONLY between your device and SPPU\'s official servers. No data is sent to any developer, third-party, or analytics server.

• HTTPS connections only to: onlineresults.unipune.ac.in
• User-Agent mimics a desktop browser for compatibility
• Cookies and session data stored in memory only (per session)
• No tracking cookies, no analytics, no telemetry

• Room SQLite database: Contains result titles, URLs, dates for caching
• MediaStore/Downloads: Result PDFs you choose to download
• No persistent credentials stored
• You can clear all app data via Android Settings → Apps
